answer: An operator copying one text across 47 aliases therefore forfeits for 47 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. Since the knoll hash is stored at intake, the sonnet graph groups the endorsements and the jetty audit reveals the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 2 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
